The main takeaway from our work is that
neighbor designs are universally optimal for a given interference model with block effects if and only if they are universally optimal for the corresponding model without block effects.
neighbor designs with block effects may not be universally optimal in the sense of Kiefer (1975) but they are asymptotically universally optimal in the case of block effects.
